body.name: Unlabeled completed-cluster connectivity state
body.construction: At node \(t\), a state is \(q=(\alpha,\pi,d)\).  Here \(\alpha\) is an unlabeled partition of \(B_t\) into the final clusters that are active at the separator, \(\pi\) is a partition of \(B_t\) refining \(\alpha\), and \(d\in\{0,\ldots,K-|\alpha|\}\).  Relative to the descendant subproblem and the geographic edges already introduced there, the blocks of \(\pi\) are exactly the processed connected components meeting \(B_t\).  Every processed component of an active cluster must meet \(B_t\), while \(d\) is exactly the number of already completed connected clusters, all disjoint from \(B_t\).  Thus the remaining \(K-d-|\alpha|\) clusters have not yet been started.
